items.title: 집 묘사
items.question: You indicated in your background survey that you live in an apartment. Tell me about your home. What does it look like? What types of rooms does it have?
script: I live in a small studio apartment in downtown Seoul. It's located in the center of Seoul.

Actually, I don't have a bedroom in my apartment because it's a small studio. But it has a really nice bathroom and a spacious kitchen area. My apartment is very clean and modern, so I really like my place.
What makes my apartment special is a big window. Whenever I open it, I can get some fresh air. Also, the window lets in a lot of light, and that makes my studio super bright and cheerful.
So, anyway, my home is the best place for me to relax and chill out. I know my studio is very small, but it's cozy and comfortable.
keywords: 서울 도심 작은 원룸 (small studio) · 서울 중심
특별한 점: 큰 창문 → 열면 fresh air
마무리: relax and chill out · 작지만 cozy and comfortable

items.title: 집에 준 변화
items.question: Have you made any changes to your house within the last few years? If so, what kinds of changes have you made? Are you satisfied with the changes?
script: Okay, well, recently, I redecorated my apartment. There are a few changes I made.
First of all, I replaced the old wallpaper, because I didn't like the old one! The new wallpaper has a bright and modern design. So, I think it makes my apartment so much brighter.

Also, I bought a new couch! Actually, I already had a small chair, but I wanted a new, comfy couch. So, I got it online last week, and I love it! It's super soft and comfortable, and I put it by the window. Oh, one more thing! I put up new curtains in the living room area. I really like the color of the new curtains. It's bright blue and yellow!
I know my apartment is quite small, but I think I have everything I need. So I love my place because it's very cozy and comfortable.
keywords: 최근에 집 redecorate · 바꾼 것 몇 가지
① 벽지 교체: 옛날 거 싫었음 → 밝고 모던 → 훨씬 밝아짐
② 새 소파: 작은 의자만 있었음 → 지난주 온라인 구매 → 창가에 둠
③ 거실 새 커튼: 밝은 파랑 + 노랑
마무리: 작지만 필요한 건 다 있음 · cozy and comfortable

items.title: 과거와 현재의 집 비교
items.question: Compare the home you lived in before to the one you live now. How is it different?
script: About 5 years ago, I moved to a small studio apartment. So, when I was younger, I used to live with my family in a big house. Back then, we lived in a big apartment, and it was located outside of Seoul. We had four bedrooms and a lot of furniture.

But now, I live alone in a small studio. It's located in the center of Seoul. There's no bedroom, and I don't have a lot of furniture. But there's a large window and that makes my apartment super bright and cheerful. My apartment is small, but it's very comfortable and cozy.
Anyway, I like my current home. I'm very happy with where I live now.
keywords: 예전: 가족과 큰 집 · 서울 외곽 · 방 4개 · 가구 많음
지금: 혼자 · 서울 중심 원룸 · 침실 없음 · 가구 적음

items.title: 좋아하는 공원
items.question: Please tell me about the park you like to go to. Where is it located? What does it look like? What makes it special? Describe your favorite park in details.
script: There's a very nice park in my neighborhood. The name of the park is Han River Park. And I think it's the largest and the best park in Seoul.
First of all, the park is quite close to my apartment. Actually, it's only a 5 to 10 minute walk. It's within walking distance of my apartment!
Also, there are so many people jogging, walking, and playing sports. Even in the morning, the park has a lot of people!
And you know what? The park is really beautiful. It has colorful flowers and trees. So, I feel relaxed and peaceful whenever I go there.
Anyway, I think Han River Park is the best place for me to hang out. Sometimes, the park is so crowded on weekends, but it's very clean and cheerful.
keywords: 동네 한강공원 · 서울에서 제일 크고 좋은 공원
예쁨: 알록달록 꽃과 나무 → relaxed and peaceful
마무리: best place to hang out · 주말엔 붐벼도 깨끗하고 밝음

items.title: 공원에서 하는 일
items.question: Tell me about what you usually do at the park. What is a typical day at the park like from beginning to end?
script: Oh, wow! It's a good question, because I love going to the park!
So, like I said in the previous question, there's a very nice park in my neighborhood.
I love going to this park with my neighbor Jenna. She lives nearby so we often hang out!
I like jogging at the park almost every morning. I usually jog around 7 o'clock in the morning!
Actually, I enjoy morning workout because it makes me feel so refreshed.
After jogging, I practice yoga with my neighbor Jenna.
She is super good, so she often teaches me yoga at the park. It's really fun!
Oh! You know what? We often get some coffee or snacks after the exercise. So, we like to go to a cafe nearby and hang out!
Overall, the park in my neighborhood is my favorite place to hang out! Also, I think I'm so lucky to live near such a nice park!
keywords: 이웃 Jenna랑 같이 감 · 근처 살아서 자주 어울림
조깅 후 Jenna랑 요가 · Jenna가 잘해서 가르쳐줌
마무리: favorite place · 좋은 공원 근처 살아서 lucky

items.title: 요가할 때 옷·장비
items.question: What do you wear or take when you do yoga? Tell me about the type of clothing you wear when you practice yoga.
script: I usually work out at the park, and I sometimes do yoga there.

When I work out, I wear something comfortable, like sweatpants or yoga pants. Also, I bring a yoga mat, sunglasses, and sunscreen because I do yoga outside. In addition, I take a large water bottle and some snacks because I get thirsty and hungry. Oh, one more thing! I bring my phone and Bluetooth earphones because I like listening to music while working out.
These are the things I usually wear and take when I do yoga. I really enjoy doing yoga at the park!
keywords: 옷: 편한 거 → 운동복 바지 or 요가 바지

items.title: 요가 계기 & 장점
items.question: What do you like about yoga? How and why did you first become interested in it? How does yoga make you feel?
script: I first became interested in doing yoga about 5 years ago. Actually, I started doing yoga at the park in my neighborhood. Back then, I was kinda overweight and wanted to lose some weight. So, I decided to exercise there.

So, now, I love practicing yoga at the park almost every day. I usually do yoga in the morning with my neighbor Jenna. You know, I definitely enjoy morning yoga with her. I mean, yoga makes me feel so refreshed and energetic. And I feel so happy and healthy after the exercise!
So... thanks to yoga, I'm more active and energetic. Oh! And you know what? I've lost a lot of weight, about 10 kilos! I highly recommend yoga because it's a great way to stay healthy.
keywords: 계기: 살 좀 쪄서 빼고 싶었음
지금: 거의 매일 아침 Jenna랑 요가
느낌: refreshed and energetic · happy and healthy
마무리: highly recommend · great way to stay healthy

items.title: 요가 중 기억에 남는 일
items.question: Please describe a memorable experience you had while doing yoga. What happened, and why was it so memorable? Give as many details as possible.
script: Okay, I tell you about my memorable experience while doing yoga. Well... It was about 5 or 6 years ago. Actually, it was the first day I moved to my neighborhood. That day, I found a nice park near my home, and started practicing yoga there.
I remember the park had so many people working out. So, I also decided to work out there, because I wanted to lose some weight back then.

While jogging, I saw a group of people doing yoga at the park. And as I was watching them, a woman came to me and talked to me. You know what? She was super cute and nice! She said, "Would you like to join us?" And I was like, "Sure! Why not?"
Actually, she was a part-time yoga teacher. I joined the yoga class, and we went jogging together after class. It was a lot of fun!
Anyway, you know, I think it was really a memorable day for me. I'm really lucky to live near such a nice park!
keywords: 집 근처 좋은 공원 발견 → 운동하는 사람 많음
살 빼고 싶어서 나도 운동 시작
조깅하다 요가 그룹 봄 → 귀엽고 친절한 여자가 "같이 할래요?"
"Sure! Why not?" → 알고 보니 파트타임 요가 강사
수업 참여 + 끝나고 같이 조깅 → a lot of fun
마무리: memorable day · 좋은 공원 근처 살아서 lucky

items.title: 좋아하는 해변·캠핑 장소
items.question: In your background survey, you indicated that you like going to beaches. Where is your favorite beach and why do you like it? What does it look like?
script: I'd like to tell you about my favorite beach park in Jeju Island. It's name is Hyeopjae Beach, and I think it's the most beautiful beach in Korea! Whenever I visit Jeju Island, I like to go camping there.
This beach park has awesome walking trails. You can take a walk along the beach there! These trails are full of palm trees and flowers! They are so pretty!
Also, the beach has clear blue water and beautiful white sand. The water is full of colorful fish! So, I just love swimming and snorkeling there!
And you know what? The beach has so many stars at night! They are super pretty! So I think it's definitely worth camping there!

Well, I can't wait for my next camping trip to the beach park. And someday, I hope to visit there with my best friend. By the way, Ava, have you been to Jeju Island? It is a beautiful island. You should go there sometime!
keywords: 제주 협재해변 · 한국에서 제일 예쁜 해변
산책로: 해변 따라 걷기 · 야자수와 꽃
맑고 파란 물 + 하얀 모래 · 알록달록 물고기 → 수영·스노클링
밤에 별 엄청 많음 → worth camping
Ava한테 질문: 제주 가봤어? 꼭 가봐

items.title: 해변·캠핑에서 하는 일
items.question: What do you usually do when you go camping or go to the beach? Tell me everything you usually do on a camping or beach trip.
script: As I said earlier, I really like camping because I love nature. My family and I go camping a couple of times a year, usually in May.

Our favorite place is a beach park in Jeju Island. We like to take a walk along the beach and take pictures. We also enjoy swimming and snorkeling. We love watching colorful fish and taking videos of them, so we bring a camera. At night, we enjoy having a barbecue with grilled beef and seafood.
Anyway, I can't wait for my next beach trip. Going to the beach is a great way to relieve stress!
keywords: 수영·스노클링 · 물고기 영상 찍으려고 카메라 챙김
마무리: 다음 여행 기대 · relieve stress

items.title: 기억에 남는 해변·캠핑
items.question: Tell me about your most memorable camping or beach trip. What happened? Who did you go with? Where was it? What made the trip so memorable?
script: My most memorable camping trip was to Jeju Island with my family. It was last spring.
We went camping at Hyeopjae Beach. I think it was the most beautiful beach I've ever seen in Korea.
We took a walk along the beach and took lots of pictures. We also swam in the clear blue water and saw many colorful fish. They were so pretty!
At night, we saw lots of stars. It was really amazing!
Overall, it was a very special trip for me. I hope to visit there again someday!
keywords: 협재해변 · 한국에서 본 제일 예쁜 해변
맑고 파란 물에서 수영 · 알록달록 물고기
마무리: very special trip · 또 가고 싶음

items.title: 캠핑 장비 & 음식
items.question: What sort of gear and food do you bring along when you go camping or when you go to the beach? How do you prepare the items and food?
script: My family and I love camping. We usually go camping at the beach. We bring a lot of things when we go camping.
First of all, we bring sleeping bags and a tent.
Also, we make sure to pack a camping stove and a lot of meat and vegetables for a barbecue.
For vegetables, we bring onions, potatoes, and mushrooms.
On top of that, we bring some snacks and drinks because we get hungry and thirsty.
Oh, one more thing! We definitely bring beach towels, swimsuits, and sunscreen because we love swimming at the beach.
Anyway, I can't wait for my next camping trip!
keywords: 가족과 보통 해변 캠핑 · 짐 많이 챙김

items.title: 집 휴가 때 하는 일
items.question: Please describe the activities you like to do during your vacations at home. What do you usually do when you spend your vacation at home?
script: I usually spend my vacations at home because my home is comfortable.
I think my home is the best place to relax.
When I stay home, I usually listen to music. I also eat snacks and sometimes take a nap.
I love listening to music because it makes me feel happy.
Sometimes, I invite my friends to my home. We order some food and watch movies together.
Well, spending my vacation at home is a great way to relax. I really enjoy it!
keywords: 가끔 친구 초대 → 음식 시켜서 영화

items.title: 기억에 남는 집 휴가
items.question: Describe one memorable experience you had during a vacation at home. What happened? Why was the vacation so unforgettable?
script: My most memorable vacation at home was when I invited my best friend to my place.
My friend came over in the afternoon.
We listened to music and talked a lot.
Also, we watched our favorite movie together.
It was so much fun to watch a movie with my best friend.
Later, we went to a park near my home and took a walk.
Well, overall, it was a really fun day! I can't wait for my next vacation!
keywords: 최애 영화 같이 봄 → so much fun
마무리: really fun day · 다음 휴가 기대

items.title: 최근 집 휴가
items.question: I'd like to know about your recent vacation at home. Tell me about the last time you spent your vacation at home. What did you do and who were you with? Was there anything memorable?
script: I'd like to tell you about my recent vacation at home.
Last vacation, I invited my friend to my apartment. We had a really good time together.
We did a lot of fun things. First, we watched a movie on YouTube, and we talked a lot about it. It was really fun.
After that, we went for a walk in a park near my home. It was a cold day, and it even snowed, so it was really beautiful.
And then, I cooked dinner and made pasta. Everything was delicious, and we all ate a lot!
After dinner, I did some household chores. I washed the dishes and cleaned my apartment.
Overall, it was a really special vacation. For my next vacation, I hope my friend invites me to her place!
keywords: ② 집 근처 공원 산책 · 추운 날 눈까지 → beautiful
③ 저녁: 내가 파스타 요리 → 다 맛있고 많이 먹음
④ 저녁 후 집안일: 설거지 + 청소
마무리: special vacation · 다음엔 친구가 나 초대해주길

items.title: 좋아하는 장르·가수
items.question: What kind of music do you like? Who is your favorite singer? Why do you like them?
script: I like listening to all kinds of music, including jazz, K-pop, rock, and so on.
So, of course, I know a lot of musicians and their music. But I enjoy pop music the most. There are so many pop musicians I like, but my all-time favorite is Coldplay.
Do you know Coldplay, Ava?
Coldplay is a famous British rock band! The band consists of four members.
The lead singer is such an amazing singer! He plays the guitar while singing at the same time! He is very handsome! I love his beautiful eyes and smile!
I sometimes watch their music videos on YouTube. Their songs are always full of energy.
I think listening to Coldplay's music is a great way for me to relieve stress.
You should give their music a try! I recommend their song called "Viva La Vida."
keywords: 제일 좋아하는 건 팝 · all-time favorite: Coldplay
리드 싱어: 기타 치면서 노래 · 잘생김 · 눈과 미소
유튜브 뮤비 · 에너지 넘침 → relieve stress

items.title: 음악 듣는 장소·시간·기기
items.question: Where and when do you usually listen to music? What do you use to listen to music?
script: Like I said earlier, I like listening to all kinds of music, such as K-pop, rock, jazz, and even classical music. Listening to music always makes me feel relaxed and comfortable.
I listen to music every morning and night. I'd have to say music is my life! When I get up in the morning, I listen to peaceful music, such as classical music.
When I'm on the subway or the bus, I like listening to cheerful music, like K-pop.
You know what? I play music on my smart phone. Thanks to technology, I can easily listen to music anywhere.
I guess music is an important part of my life! I have to say I can't live without music. How about you, Ava? Do you like music?
keywords: 매일 아침·밤 · music is my life
기기: 스마트폰 · thanks to technology 어디서든
마무리: can't live without music · Ava는?

items.title: 최근 콘서트 경험
items.question: Tell me about a concert that you have been to recently. Where was the concert held and who did you go with? Did you enjoy the concert?
script: I want to tell you about my concert experience.
It was about 5 years ago, on my birthday. My friend bought me a Coldplay concert ticket as a birthday present.

I was so excited because Coldplay is my favorite band. When they came on stage, everyone cheered. They sang many famous songs, and I sang along. Especially, when they sang "Viva La Vida", I was so happy!
The concert was amazing. It was one of the best birthday presents ever. I'll never forget that day!
keywords: 무대 등장 → 다들 환호 · 유명곡 따라 부름
Viva La Vida 때 너무 행복
마무리: best birthday present · 절대 못 잊음

items.title: 음악 계기 & 취향 변화
items.question: How did you first become interested in listening to music? When did you start listening to music? Has your taste in music changed over the years? Talk about how your taste in music has changed.
script: When I was young, I didn't really like music. I didn't like music because it was too loud.
I first became interested in music when I was 15. My friend bought me a classical music CD for my birthday. My friend really liked music.
Now, I like all kinds of music. But I like pop music the most. I especially like Coldplay. Their lead singer is such an amazing singer!
Do you like music, Ava? You should listen to Coldplay's music!
keywords: 어릴 땐 음악 별로 · 너무 시끄러워서
15살: 음악 좋아하는 친구가 생일선물로 클래식 CD
지금: 다 좋아하지만 팝이 최고 · 특히 Coldplay

items.title: 좋아하는 영화 장르
items.question: In your background survey, you indicated that you enjoy watching movies. What is your favorite type of movie and why?
script: I like watching all kinds of movies, including romance, comedy, thrillers, and even documentaries!

However, I enjoy watching sci-fi movies the most. Well, I think sci-fi movies are very creative and imaginative. Have you seen a movie like The Martian? It is an awesome sci-fi movie! You can see life on Mars in this movie.
Also, sci-fi movies have amazing special effects! I love watching those amazing effects in a theater.
Oh! My favorite sci-fi movie is Inception. Maybe I've seen this movie more than five times!
Anyway, watching movies is the best way for me to relieve stress. I can say that sci-fi movies are always fun and entertaining!
keywords: 제일 좋아하는 건 SF → creative and imaginative
특수효과 amazing · 극장에서 보는 거 좋아함
마무리: relieve stress · fun and entertaining

items.title: 좋아하는 영화배우
items.question: Who is your favorite actor? What movies has this actor starred in? What do you like about him or her? Please provide me as many details as possible.
script: Actually, I know a lot of great actors. There are so many actors I like! And my all-time favorite is Leonardo DiCaprio. I'm a big fan of Leonardo DiCaprio!
I think Leonardo DiCaprio is the most handsome actor! He has beautiful eyes and a dazzling smile. He looks so much younger.

Also, I think he's a very hard-working and energetic person. And of course, he seems very fit and healthy! He's such a great actor! I think he has amazing acting skills! So, I've seen all of his movies, like Romeo and Juliet, Titanic, Inception, and so on.
Well, overall, Leonardo DiCaprio is one of the greatest actors in the world! His movies always make me feel better.
keywords: 좋아하는 배우 많음 · all-time favorite: 디카프리오
제일 잘생김 · 예쁜 눈 + dazzling smile · 동안
영화 다 봄: 로미오와 줄리엣 · 타이타닉 · 인셉션
마무리: greatest actor · 영화 보면 기분 좋아짐

items.title: 영화 보러 갈 때 루틴
items.question: What is your routine when you go to the theater? What do you do before going to the movies? What about after? Please describe your routine in detail.
script: I love watching all kinds of movies. I like watching movies at home, but I also enjoy going to the theater. I usually go to the movies a couple of times a month with my friends.

Before watching a movie, we usually take a walk in a nearby park. Then, we buy some popcorn and drinks. We love eating snacks while watching a movie. After the movie, we usually have dinner at a nearby restaurant and talk about the movie. Well, I really enjoy going to the movies. It's a great way to spend my free time!
keywords: 후: 근처 식당 저녁 + 영화 얘기
마무리: great way to spend my free time

items.title: 기억에 남는 영화
items.question: Tell me about a movie you remember the best. What was it about? Who was in it? How did you feel when watching it? Please describe the movie in detail.
script: Like I said in the previous question, I like all kinds of movies, including action movies, thrillers, romances, and so on.
But I enjoy watching science fiction movies the best.
And I think the best sci-fi movie so far is Inception.
The story of Inception was definitely new, original, and even shocking!
While watching it, I felt like I was actually in their dreams. It was crazy!
Honestly, it was kind of difficult to understand the movie.
So, maybe I've seen it five times!
Also, Leonardo DiCaprio starred in this movie.
His character seemed so real and believable. It was amazing!
I remember I watched this movie with my best friend at the theater.
Well, anyway, Inception is such a great movie! I highly recommend watching it!
keywords: 보는 동안 꿈속에 있는 느낌 → crazy
디카프리오 주연 · 캐릭터 real and believable

items.title: 영화 계기 & 취향 변화
items.question: How did you become interested in watching movies? Has your taste in movies changed over time? How are the movies you enjoy now different from those in the past?
script: I like all kinds of movies, and I really enjoy watching them.
But when I was younger, I wasn't interested in movies, so I didn't watch them.
When I was 21, I started watching movies.
Now, I often watch movies at home on Netflix. Sometimes, I go to the theater.
I like all kinds of movies, but my favorite type is science fiction.
I especially like sci-fi movies because they are creative and exciting. Also, the special effects are really cool.
My favorite movie is Inception.
Well, anyway, watching movies is a great way to relieve stress. I really enjoy it!
keywords: 어릴 땐 관심 없어서 안 봄
최애 장르 SF → creative and exciting · 특수효과 cool
